text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand the cause of the newborn's jaundice, could you please tell me the baby's current age in days and their birth weight?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the baby been producing adequate wet and dirty diapers, and is she feeding well? I also need to know if there is any family history of jaundice or hemolytic disorders.

text: The normal ultrasound and isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia make biliary atresia unlikely, despite the family history. I need to rule out hemolytic causes such as ABO or Rh incompatibility, so REQUEST TEST: Blood_Typing_and_Coombs_Test.
